summary: DT Cloud Star Acquisition Corp (DTSQ), a Cayman blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting its October 1, 2026 annual meeting results and related amendments: shareholders approved extending the business combination period twelve months, from October 26, 2026 to October 26, 2027, funded by a $0.033 per remaining public share monthly deposit into the Wilmington Trust-managed trust account, plus a fourth amended and restated memorandum and articles of association. Roughly 75.72% of 3,653,409 ordinary shares were represented, and five directors were elected. Watch redemption levels, monthly cash burn, and any announced target or deal termination.
